name: Icha Love Dousei Seikatsu -Osananajimi to Asa kara Ban made Icha Icha Icha Icha-
original_name: いちゃラブ同棲せ～かつ 幼馴染みと朝から晩までいちゃいちゃいちゃいちゃ
source:
Childhood friends Kengo and Mutsumi like each other, but they never have the chance to confess. One day, due to protecting Mutsumi, Kengo gets into an accident and injures his hand.

Since he lives alone, this is a great inconvenience. However, Mutsumi suggests that she will live with him and take care of everything. And so, their erotic life begins.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=955312]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
青梅竹马健吾和睦美彼此喜欢，却一直没有机会告白。一天，健吾为了保护睦美遭遇事故，手受了伤。

由于他独自生活，这带来了很大不便。于是睦美提议和他同住，照料他的一切。两人的性爱生活就此开始。
